// Positive control (#5170): `kind !== 'found'` covers `unreadable` too, and skips for both.
import { gateVerdict } from './gate-verdict.cjs';
import { readTextEvidence } from './gate-evidence.cjs';

export function evaluateFixtureGate(planPath: string) {
  const plan = readTextEvidence(planPath);
  if (plan.kind !== 'found') {
    return gateVerdict('skip', false, { reason: 'nothing to check' });
  }
  return gateVerdict('pass', false, { text: plan.value });
}
